verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a SaaS email product, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path (all returned 404), and no evidence item mentions a downloadable spec. The official MCP server is a different capability (an agent connector, not a downloadable API spec), so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
